mismatch.message: unsupported hero command: an unported branch of this command: unsupported steed action: dismount_steed() dropping the steed into liquid

summary: The v57 #ride case reaches the liquid-square branch in steed.c:dismount_steed. C runs its water and lava handling only when grounded(mdat) is true, but js/steed.js refuses any is_pool or is_lava square before that source condition.

source.branch: DISMOUNT_BYCHOICE releases a mounted silver dragon while the hero is on a pool square. C checks grounded(mdat) before water or lava effects; a flying steed skips those effects and continues to teleds/float_down. The same function has related missing branches for grounded steeds, save_utrap/mintrap, DISMOUNT_BONES, and the no-adjacent-square DISMOUNT_BYCHOICE outcome.
callers: steed.c:doride calls dismount_steed(DISMOUNT_BYCHOICE) for #ride; js/steed.js:doride calls the exported JavaScript function.
timeout.c:slip_or_trip and trap.c call dismount_steed for falling or trap-related mount release; js/timeout.js still contains the steed.c dismount gap within A2’s reserved caller scope.
dependencies: mondata.h:23-28 defines grounded(ptr) and cant_drown(ptr) as macros; js/mondata.js already implements grounded, swimmer, amphibious, and breathless predicates.
A whole dismount_steed port must preserve timeout.c:slip_or_trip caller wiring; A2 currently owns js/timeout.js and timeout.c:slip_or_trip.

evidence: The saved v57 admission evaluation at 01813882f5ec9612667f08b17e1630f732d78381 reports 277/308 screens and cursors, 2887/2902 RNG calls, and the unsupported dismount branch at step 277; manifest and recording digests match the selected queue entry.

A selected-case diagnostic on dcddfcf364a09a944572f02347b20a488a851d4d stops at step 277 during the pool dismount. The C recording names the steed as a silver dragon and reaches the #ride command after entering the pool.
nethack-c/upstream/src/steed.c:576-822 checks grounded(mdat) before is_pool/is_lava messages, cant_drown/likes_lava, killed, and adjalign; non-grounded steeds continue to teleds and float_down.

nethack-c/upstream/include/mondata.h:23-28 defines grounded and cant_drown. js/mondata.js:201-207 already implements grounded(species,state), while js/steed.js:1019-1027 rejects the liquid square without calling grounded.

The related v56 mounted-web case first stops in the same C function at the save_utrap/mintrap branch. A whole-function port would address both sessions; completion also requires resolving the existing timeout.js caller gap, which overlaps A2’s reserved scope.
